verdict.rationale: 2FAS is an authenticator app, so push sign-in with phishing defenses is a fair axis. The evidence only shows a browser-extension flow where you confirm token delivery on the phone. Nothing documents number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies, and the product is described as anonymous and account-free, which leaves no admin layer.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
